authority: agent-authored advisory testing, not requester-prescribed effects
concept: Rainy blue-hour harbor repair booth: a reference-guided fictional adult woman unwraps a mended glazed cup for its waiting owner.
strict_rule: PASS only when all three effects and reference-scope/physical gates pass in native pixels; PARTIAL is FAIL; blocked image generation is unscored.

tests.expected: Fine irregular luminance texture visible across flat blue doorway shadows and cream wall midtones, distinct from scene material and compression blocks.
tests.partial_rule: Only material texture or no inspectable grain means FAIL.

tests.expected: Narrow red-orange halo localized along the bright task-bulb boundary against dark beam; nearby midtone edges stay comparatively crisp.
tests.partial_rule: General warm light without a localized edge halo means FAIL.

tests.expected: Skin, glaze and wrapping retain smooth tonal transition and texture toward bright pale regions.
tests.partial_rule: If only one material preserves a transition while others visibly clip, PARTIAL therefore FAIL.

physical_gates: Cup base contacts supporting right palm
reference_gate: Visible dark bob and wispy fringe, broad face/eye/lip appearance guidance remains reasonably represented for fictional adult; no identity equivalence is scored.
